status: DRAFT - not binding; no training until the review pilot is adjudicated and the user approves
hypothesis: Keep the existing real-name output unchanged; add only those personal_handle candidates that a personal-reference context classifier accepts. This cannot exceed the fixed candidate set's coverage of nickname gold.

fixed_candidate_set_coverage_dev.note: small counts, already-opened slices; thresholded at 0.9

declared_targets: KDPII test 500 and fresh 1992, policy PS_NAME+PS_NICKNAME: F1 (A vs candidate, same gold)
paired contexts (192): non_personal flagged by candidate must be 0 beyond A's 11
required_not_to_regress: per-source constraints of the main preregistration

data.train_pool: official KDPII v1 train, minus 245 evaluation-identical texts, nickname/handle rows from the survey; official valid minus 20 identical texts for checkpoint selection
data.review_pilot: name_handle_pilot_v1 (400) is a development/review set, not training data until adjudicated; never mixed with the 192 paired contexts or the opened evaluation slices
data.split_rule: group-aware by VERIFIED original conversation ID (prefix assumption still unverified); templates and near variants stay in one split; held-out subset of unseen nickname strings flagged
unresolved: policy for generic terms of endearment
whether PS_ID (account handles) is trained together with PS_NICKNAME

training: Three pre-registered seeds each must pass; zero tolerance on the three per-span regressions; Delta F1 lower bound > 0 with the paired 10,000-resample bootstrap of amendment 2.
checkpoint_selection: NOT approved for this task. source_macro_rank (real-name F1 macro) is not suitable by itself; a selection formula covering nickname F1 and non-personal context false flags must be proposed and approved before training.
scale: Training/evaluation scale is decided after the pilot reports yield, independent conversations, annotation difficulty and expected precision; data is not added until a candidate passes.
